inProgressResult.description: The result for which data has to be retrieved.

input.description: The string query for which the data has to be retrieved

structuredQuerySpec.description:
The structured query spec to execute to retrieve data.
If passed the tool will not generate a new spec using Llm, but will instead use this to execute and return the output of the passed spec.
Otherwise the tool will first generate a new spec using Llm and then execute it.
Note that the spec should be valid for the tool to execute and retrieve data.
